subject: history_social
notes: The Suez Canal in Egypt opened in 1869.
It connects the Mediterranean Sea with the Red Sea, allowing ships to avoid sailing around Africa.
It connects the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans, allowing ships to avoid sailing around South America.
The Panama Canal uses locks to raise and lower ships; the Suez Canal has no locks.
stem: The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the two canals. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The Suez Canal opened in 1869, while the Panama Canal opened 45 years later, in 1914.
choices.B: Unlike the Suez Canal, which has no locks, the Panama Canal uses locks to raise and lower ships.
choices.C: The Panama Canal connects the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans, allowing ships to avoid sailing around South America.
choices.D: Both the Suez Canal and the Panama Canal spare ships a long voyage around a continent: Africa in one case and South America in the other.

explanation.why: A similarity needs both canals and something they have in common. The notes show that each canal lets ships avoid sailing around a continent, so the best choice states that shared purpose for both.
explanation.A: Incorrect. It compares the opening dates, which highlights a difference of 45 years, not a similarity.
explanation.B: Incorrect. "Unlike" signals a difference: one canal has locks and the other does not.
explanation.C: Incorrect. It describes only the Panama Canal, so it cannot show what the two canals share. This is tempting because the fact it gives is half of the similarity.
explanation.D: Correct. It uses "Both" and shows the shared purpose: each canal lets ships avoid going around a continent.

checks.note: Best fit on the text alone.
